puzzleManagement.successActionRequestScan: Request Scan Result from GM Again
puzzleManagement.feedbackSettings: Feedback Settings (Short message immediately after solving)
puzzleManagement.solutionSequenceNotes: Enter button numbers starting from 1, separated by commas (not starting from 0).

puzzleManagement.targetEntityNotes: Specify the Actor, Journal, or Item to grant permission for upon puzzle success.
puzzleManagement.allowTransmissionNotes: If enabled, the player can transmit the info acquired from this puzzle (Actor/Journal access rights) to other contacts via message.
puzzleManagement.transmitToTitle: Select a recipient to transmit info
puzzleManagement.dataPacketClickToReveal: Click an item below to reveal the information.
puzzleManagement.alreadyHasPermission: You already have permission to access '{documentName}'.
puzzleManagement.confirmViewAccessContent: Access granted for {documentName}. Would you like to view it now?
puzzleManagement.startLengthMaxWarning: Start length can be set to a maximum of 7.
puzzleManagement.lengthIncrementMaxWarning: Length increment can be set to a maximum of 5.
puzzleManagement.totalStagesMaxWarning: Total stages can be set to a maximum of 5.
puzzleManagement.buttonCountMaxWarning: The number of buttons can be set to a maximum of 9.
puzzleManagement.sequenceLengthNotes: Set the length of the code the player must guess (3-6).
puzzleManagement.buttonCountNotes: Set the number of possible symbols (buttons) to be used in the code (4-8).
puzzleManagement.maxAttemptsNotes: The maximum number of chances the player has to guess the code (5-20).
puzzleManagement.startLengthNotes: Set the starting length of the sequence (1-7).
puzzleManagement.lengthIncrementNotes: Set the length to add after each successful stage (0-5).
puzzleManagement.totalStagesNotes: Set the total number of stages the player must complete (1-5).
puzzleManagement.memoryButtonCountNotes: Set the number of buttons to be used in the puzzle (2-9).
puzzleManagement.encryptOnArchiveNotes: When enabled, the information obtained from this puzzle is saved to the Data Archive in an 'encrypted' state. The player must decrypt this data again.
puzzleManagement.decryptPuzzleNotes: When encryption is enabled, select another puzzle to use for decrypting the data. If not selected, this puzzle itself will be used.
puzzleManagement.frequencySpeedNotes: Higher values mean faster cursor speed. (Default: 3)
puzzleManagement.frequencyAccelerationNotes: Percentage speed increase upon success. (0~50, Default: 15)
puzzleManagement.circuitSpecialNotes: Includes tiles that cannot be rotated.
puzzleManagement.circuitMovesNotes: Multiplier for the automatically calculated move limit.
puzzleManagement.circuitTrapNotes: Includes traps that reduce energy when powered.
puzzleManagement.mazeDifficultyNotes: Higher levels create larger, more complex mazes.
puzzleManagement.mazeTimeLimitNotes: Time in seconds to complete the maze. (Default: 30)
puzzleManagement.mazeMaxKeysNotes: Number of key/lock obstacles on the maze path.
